01_abc.title: Inside the Torus (ABC)
cues: These glowing tracers follow an exact special fluid solution called A-B-C flow on a repeating box.
The gold lines show the fluid's spin — its vorticity.
Viscosity steadily reduces the kinetic energy. Watch E on the readout match the exact formula.
This shows one smooth special case only. It does not solve the general three-D regularity problem.

02_tg.title: Taylor–Green Cells
cues: Here is Taylor–Green flow: counter-rotating columns in a repeating box.
The vertical lines show spin pointing along the columns.
Energy decays exactly as predicted, and helicity stays zero. One exact special solution — not general regularity.

03_p2q_art.title: P2Q Kernel Jumps (artistic layer)
cues: The particles still follow the real A-B-C fluid solution.
The violet arcs illustrate transitions — an artistic idea inspired by Benjamin's P-2-Q research.
This film does not calculate quantum-jump dynamics. The numbers on screen come from the fluid math alone.
